key_idea: Sieve primes up to R, multiply those in [L,R] mod p, then raise the product to the E-th power.
sketch: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 1e6, accumulate the product of primes in [L,R] modulo 1e9+7, and apply fast exponentiation once with exponent E. Empty range of primes (e.g. L=R=1) yields 1. O(R log log R). Use 64-bit for products.
